primary_hypothesis: A learned bounded extractive view improves contextual review over recency and lexical retrieval at comparable review burden.

engineering_study.source: paired-scope-117 training partition only; v9 test remains a regression set
engineering_study.family_assignment: Sort 36 content-family identifiers by SHA256 canonical JSON; first 20 train, next 6 development, last 10 calibration; shared assignment across languages.
engineering_study.augmentation: 0, 4, 12 or 30 synthetic distractor turns before focal turn; original spans weakly labeled relevant
engineering_study.challenge: 32 unreviewed developer-authored cases, four paired bilingual scenario families, gaps 0/8/32/100; development diagnostic only
engineering_study.model: 4096 hashed word/character features; logistic heads C=8, max_iter=400, seed=1010; 3000-character learned evidence budget
engineering_study.selection: One shared review cutoff minimizes development misses, then false reviews; no challenge-based selection
engineering_study.calibration: Language-stratified split conformal at alpha=0.1; maximum nonconformity per scenario family; undersized calibration returns all worlds
engineering_study.response_head: 20 developer-authored training replies and 10 separate diagnostic replies; no semantic quality qualification
engineering_study.distillation: Optional frozen v9 soft targets from training prefixes only; equal-weight supervised anchors; separate candidate and calibration

independent_study.annotation: Two independent labels and evidence spans per prefix; disagreements adjudicated; allow unresolved and outside-ontology labels.
independent_study.sample_size: Determine from a pilot, family dependence and preregistered minimum detectable paired effect before authoring the final test.
independent_study.reviewer_study: Blinded counterbalanced case assignment, no repeated case per reviewer; accuracy and measured elapsed review time; human cost is separate from symbolic question cost.

metrics: false alerts and review/abstention burden per 1000 benign conversations
delay after first annotated review-worthy checkpoint and missed conversations
joint interpretation coverage and set size
